rationale: The Chief Justice is likely to keep the opinion to narrow statutory grounds (text/structure of § 5321 and contrast with willful provisions) and assign either to himself or to a careful stylist (Kagan) who can hold a broad coalition. Gorsuch/Barrett/Thomas have elevated separation-of-powers and strict-construction themes that could prompt concurrences, while Alito is likely to write a solo dissent emphasizing § 5314’s account-focused regulatory scheme and deterrence.
